AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#674 @ f9e21a87bf47502458a6ae21c2393010a1279198 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/2/2

Lens AUD-SOL-CM-118, agent 118. Independent T4 review of M1's complete piece inputs and round-3 delta: refund/dispute/transfer callers, source claims and postings, database concurrency/lock order, retry/reconcile completeness, owner authorization, additive migrations/RLS/down scripts, CI live-test wiring and changed tests/runbook. [Exact head and round 3](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/674#issuecomment-5982570833)

## Prior findings and evidence applicability

No original #641 Sol APPROVE is inherited wholesale; prior evidence is reused only on its bounded unchanged inputs, with the same-model acceptance assertions re-executed independently against this head. [Previous Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/674#issuecomment-5977398163) [Fresh independent execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913)

- **B-674-11 closes on its reported starvation boundary:** durable least-recent-attempt order, cooldown and atomic sweep claim reach the formerly starved dispute; original fairness and restarted/overlapping/cooldown controls pass. [Independent passing controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913) [Attributable failing-before assertions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186748565)
- **B-674-12 closes on both occurrence-time boundaries:** database null-to-timestamp election preserves one `closed_at` and one refund `posted_at`, with all four exact-head disposable-Postgres held-row-lock races passing, including the trigger-observed first-close/first-success cases; original stale-snapshot and candidate controls also pass. [Exact-head live execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37219217342/job/111485943834) [Independent controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913) [Close failing-before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37186763956) [Refund failing-before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37219181506)
- Earlier CAS, owner native-HTTP allow/deny, webhook-before-record, source/receipt once-only, head-posting commit-failure and closed-log/privacy assertions remain passing on their reported boundaries; the send-retention and incomplete-list gaps below are additional must-fix paths, not proof that those passing controls failed. [Independent M1 controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913)
- The builder's only red replay assertion expects the removed intermediate webhook-mirror write (`mirror_before_reconcile=122` rather than observer-only zero); the same execution converges to Stripe/local 122/122, so this obsolete intermediate expectation is not treated as a regression or waived financial loss. [Builder replay, 132 passing controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37219308935) [Reported single-writer implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f9e21a87bf47502458a6ae21c2393010a1279198/src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts)

## B — must fix

### B-674-13 — the sweep can resend a refund reversal after Stripe forgets its key

**Where:** `src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts:743–795,687–696`: the sweep captures one `now`, derives the initial expiry set from it, and supplies that same timestamp to every subsequent reversal admission, regardless of actual elapsed provider/DB time. [Exact retry/admission implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f9e21a87bf47502458a6ae21c2393010a1279198/src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts)

**Executed counterexample:** the default bounded sweep permits 1,000 rows; 370 preceding failed reversal calls each consume the actual configured 10-second provider timeout, then a refund whose lost-answer reversal was 22h59m old at sweep start is sent at age **24h00m40s**, after modeled key retention expires. [Actual-service, synthetic-clock/provider execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913)

The provider has **244 cents reversed**, the local transfer has **122**, and the refund is terminal instead of in review; the lane fails the 122-cent once-only assertion, not compilation or infrastructure. [Executed cents and admission state](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913)

**Minimal fix rule:** re-evaluate retention using fresh actual send-time authority for every refund immediately before the external request; route expired/uncertain requests to review, and bound elapsed sweep work without losing durable fairness, original key/amount or atomic source claims.

**Verify:** retain `test/audit-sol-cm-118-send-admission.spec.ts`'s long-sweep assertion; add expiry crossed between selection/admission/send, restart/overlap controls, and unchanged refund/dispute/reconcile/live contention coverage. [Builder-ready failing probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913)

### B-674-14 — an explicitly incomplete Stripe list authorizes another reversal

**Where:** `src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts:1081–1084`, consumed by `applyDisputeTransferReversalOnce` at `1220–1237` and owner reconcile: `has_more=true` with an empty page is returned as successful complete absence. [Exact list and consumers](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f9e21a87bf47502458a6ae21c2393010a1279198/src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts)

**Executed counterexample:** an owed lost dispute has a prior 122-cent Stripe receipt and an expired key; the synthetic provider explicitly reports an incomplete/no-progress page (`data=[]`, `has_more=true`), yet the recovery path sends again and ends with **Stripe 244/local 122** rather than staying pending with no send. [Exact-source fail-closed probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913)

This is incomplete-provider-response resilience evidence, not a claim that a real Stripe response was observed; an incomplete list cannot establish the absence that authorizes a fresh money movement. [Probe methodology and actual branch execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913)

**Minimal fix rule:** return success only after explicit complete pagination; fail closed with a closed actionable error on empty-with-more, no-progress/repeated-cursor or otherwise incomplete pages, before either recovery consumer may send.

**Verify:** keep the incomplete-dispute-list assertion and add the owner-reconcile equivalent, a nonempty first page followed by no progress, complete empty-list control and the existing 1,000-row cap; incomplete lists must leave the obligation owed and make no external reversal. [Builder-ready failing probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913)

## C — carried, optional

- **C-674-6:** `refund-dispute-handler.service.ts:952,1054` still lets provider listing/send outages escape owner reconciliation as a generic server error; map them to a closed actionable 502/503 explaining that local recording did not finish and reconciliation can be retried. [Current reconcile boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f9e21a87bf47502458a6ae21c2393010a1279198/src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts)
- **C-674-7:** `refund-reversal-admin.controller.ts:52–74` still does not forward the authenticated acting owner; persist owner id/time/outcome with safe ids-only attribution, never request/provider free text. [Current owner controller](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f9e21a87bf47502458a6ae21c2393010a1279198/src/checkout/refund-reversal-admin.controller.ts)

## CI, scope and proof limits

Independent lane `37221208913`, execution SHA `a0f5d8e805cd8a059d2cab101359248ab49f6050`, executes **2 new failed acceptance assertions / 74 passing controls**; its implementation is byte-identical to this head, with only audit/test copies and the approved one-job workflow/manifest added. [Attributable audit lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913)

All eleven required candidate checks are green; size is **2,948 changed lines**, under the hard cap but in the operator SIZE ASSESSMENT band, and the PR remains behind main. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37219217342) [Size/head evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/674#issuecomment-5982570833)

The new findings use actual services over stateful DB/synthetic provider/clock doubles; the separate concurrency assurance is real disposable Postgres, not live Stripe or production/device acceptance. [New proof boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37221208913) [Live DB boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37219217342/job/111485943834)

Default: fix B-674-13/14 in M1, preserving tests within the size gate, then restack M3/M4 and obtain fresh exact-head dual verdicts; no merge/deploy approval is implied.
